Thanks Aisha — good notes. High level answers and actions below; I'll attach the formal checklist and the minimal SAML/SCIM mapping doc by EOD.

1) IP allowlist
   - Confirmed ranges (prod only): 34.66.128.0/20, 52.23.64.0/20. We recommend staging mirror with the same blocks.
   - We will provide a signed-off CSV for your firewall team.

2) Service account pattern (SCIM)
   - Please ask infra to create: svc-redwood-scim@finedge.svc (key-based, long-lived machine credential).
   - Scope: scim:users:write, scim:groups:read. We will only accept key-auth from that account for provisioning calls.

3) SAML assertions
   - No attribute changes expected other than nameID format (we'll accept persistent or email). Audience will be https://auth.redwood.com/saml/acs
   - I'll include a sample metadata XML.

4) Rollback / escalation
   - If auth errors within first 15 minutes, revert IP/route to pre-cutover (Vanessa will coordinate). If SCIM errors persist, we will pause provisioning and revert to token-based bulk sync.

Action items (owners):
 - Marcus: finalize checklist + metadata XML (today) 
 - Vanessa: schedule cutover window in PagerDuty + on-call (tomorrow)
 - Ben: prepare canary service account and run smoke provisioning (Thursday)
 - Monica: confirm monitoring hooks and alerting thresholds (Thursday)

Attached: redwood-sso-scim-checklist.xlsx (first draft).

If this looks good I'll create the cutover runbook in the shared Drive and send the DocuSign link for the PO.

Best,
Marcus Lin
